comment: The Background theme menu is on Blank alone. No other module in the installed 2.0.1 build overrides appendContextMenu for it, so the theme cannot be reached by right-clicking any other Mockba Modular panel. Choosing a theme repaints this Blank at once and writes the choice to MockbaModular.json; other modules read that file in their widget constructors, so they take the new background when they are added or when Rack next starts, not immediately. Read from src/Blank.cpp and src/MockbaModular.cpp at commit d2138a2, the 2.0.1 tree.
